DirectoryEnvelope.description:
Directory-envelope binding: the top-level object written as ``evidence_envelope.json`` at the root of a bundle directory.

The ``subject`` is a free-form dict carrying the case-specific payload
(certification verdict, gateway claims, handoff manifest, ...). Subjects
are themselves schema-tagged via the legacy schema names, so consumers
can route on either ``envelope_kind`` (preferred) or
``subject["schema"]`` (legacy compat).

envelope_kind.description: Dispatch case: 'certification' (ADR-012), 'gateway_airgap' (gateway air-gap validation), or 'handoff' (operator export pack).
envelope_kind.title: Envelope Kind

reproducibility.description: Legacy smrforge.reproducibility_block.v1 mirror of ``runtime_identity`` -- kept for one release for backward-compatible readers; will be removed alongside the deprecated schema (ADR-014).
reproducibility.title: Reproducibility

runtime_identity.description: Canonical smrforge.runtime_identity.v1 block (ADR-014). Single source of truth for who/what/where/when produced this envelope.
runtime_identity.title: Runtime Identity

sha256sums_sha256.description: SHA-256 of sha256sums.txt; pins the integrity list.
sha256sums_sha256.title: Sha256Sums Sha256

subject.description: Case-specific payload. Carries its own legacy schema header for downstream consumers that still grep on names like 'smrforge.certification_manifest.v1'.
subject.title: Subject

DirectoryEnvelope.title: DirectoryEnvelope

EnvelopeArtifact.description: Single bundle artifact with SHA-256 digest.
EnvelopeArtifact.title: EnvelopeArtifact

LeanBundle.description: Lean single-JSON binding: the whole envelope in one ``*.bundle.json`` document (the form SMRForge ships from ``smrforge reproduce``). The seal is carried in-line: a per-section ``manifest`` (inputs/result/provenance, each a SHA-256 digest plus its value), a ``sha256sums`` roll-up, and a ``bundle_sha256`` over the sealed digest-list. Redaction withholds a section's ``value`` (keeping its digest) and drops the corresponding readable top-level copy -- ``result`` for a withheld result, ``reproducibility`` for a withheld provenance -- while KEEPING the signature, which still verifies over the unchanged seal. So ``result`` and ``reproducibility`` are required only when the bundle is not redacted (no ``redaction`` block). ``additionalProperties: true`` keeps the form forward-compatible: the diagnostic ``host`` block (outside the signed manifest), the ``redaction`` marker, and future keys are permitted.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the sealed digest-list; the value the signature covers.

redaction.description: Present on a docket-safe redacted derivative (smrforge.evidence_envelope.redaction.v1): names the withheld sections and pins the parent's bundle_sha256. Its presence relaxes the result/reproducibility requirement, since a withheld section's readable copy is dropped.

reproducibility.description: Readable copy of the reproducibility block; MUST agree with manifest.provenance.value. Dropped when provenance is withheld (redaction).

result.description: The result core (smrforge.result.v1 or equivalent). Opaque to this binding beyond being an object. Dropped when the result is withheld (redaction).

LeanBundle.title: LeanBundle

LeanManifest.description: Per-section seal: each of inputs/result/provenance carries a SHA-256 digest plus (unless redacted) its value.

provenance.description: The signed copy of the reproducibility block; its value (when present) MUST be a LeanReproducibility.

LeanManifest.title: LeanManifest

LeanReproducibility.description: The reproducibility contract for a lean bundle. Appears both as the top-level ``reproducibility`` (readable) and as ``manifest.provenance.value`` (signed); the two MUST agree.

data_library.description: The data-library identity actually used, or the literal marker 'unpinned' when none is externally pinned.

data.description: Residual run-scoped signed facts that are neither the standard reproducibility keys nor lineage (e.g. pack_id, temperature). Present only when a card recorded such facts.

data_library_sha256.description: NORMATIVE DIGEST RULE: MUST be a lowercase 'sha256:<64 hex>' digest binding the data actually used; a conforming verifier MUST reject any other value.

lineage.description: Present only on composed results: the ordered chain of capability steps that produced this bundle.

LeanReproducibility.title: LeanReproducibility

LeanSection.description: One sealed manifest section: a SHA-256 digest plus (unless redacted) the value it seals.
LeanSection.title: LeanSection

LeanSha256Sums.description: Roll-up of the three section digests.
LeanSha256Sums.title: LeanSha256Sums

LeanSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over bundle_sha256. Optional at the bundle level as a schema matter, but redaction KEEPS it (the seal is unchanged, so the original signature still verifies over a redacted copy); the schema validates its structure, not the signature's cryptographic validity.
LeanSignature.title: LeanSignature

description: The 'smrforge.evidence_envelope.v1' format has two serializations under this one schema identity: the directory envelope (a bundle directory whose root holds ``evidence_envelope.json``) and the lean single-JSON bundle (the whole envelope in one ``*.bundle.json`` document, as shipped by ``smrforge reproduce``). A document conforms if it matches exactly one binding; the two are disjoint by their required-field sets (a directory envelope has ``envelope_kind``/``producer``/``sha256sums_sha256``; a lean bundle has ``manifest``/``sha256sums``/``bundle_sha256``).
title: EvidenceEnvelope
